question: Show all pairs of entertainers and customers who each have up to three style strengths or preferences, where the first and second style preferences of the customers match the first and second style strengths of the entertainers (or in reverse order). Only return the entertainer’s stage name and the customer’s last name
sql:
-- Get top 2 style strengths for each entertainer (ranked by StyleStrength DESC)
WITH entertainer_top2 AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID, StyleStrength,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleStrength DESC, StyleID) as rn
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
    WHERE StyleStrength <= 3
),
entertainer_styles AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_style,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_style
    FROM entertainer_top2
    WHERE rn <= 2
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
),
-- Get top 2 preferences for each customer (ranked by PreferenceSeq ASC)
customer_top2 AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, StyleID, PreferenceSeq,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY PreferenceSeq ASC, StyleID) as rn
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    WHERE PreferenceSeq <= 3
),
customer_prefs AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_pref,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_pref
    FROM customer_top2
    WHERE rn <= 2
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
FROM entertainer_styles es
JOIN customer_prefs cp ON 1=1
JOIN Entertainers e ON es.EntertainerID = e.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers c ON cp.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE (es.first_style = cp.first_pref AND es.second_style = cp.second_pref)
   OR (es.first_style = cp.second_pref AND es.second_style = cp.first_pref)
ORDER BY e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
